name: Gauge Wall
desc: A control-room board of analog instruments: moving-coil needles overshoot and settle against engraved scales, counter drums roll their digits over, edgewise meters creep into the red, annunciator lamps latch and glow, and a miniature recorder inks its own trace while a raking room light crawls across the brushed panels.

energy.doc: needle liveliness, lamp glow and audio response

density.doc: how many instrument tiles fill the board (12 to 40)

speed.doc: rate multiplier for the plant's programme

wear.doc: scuffing, oxide bloom and thumb wear on the panels

hue.doc: panel + dial hue (offset from the style anchor)

style.doc: aesthetic: warm brass-bezelled instruments on aluminium / grey-green Soviet control room / dark bakelite and cream dials / radically abstracted — the whole board as a luminous wireframe X-ray with no dial faces at all

act.doc: multi-minute programme: the plant holding load / a slow cold start walking every needle up from zero / an excursion swinging the board through the red with alarms latching
